For many working professionals, it is a dream to be near work in comfort and convenience. Kots Aube in Hennur, Bangalore, meets this dream for its residents and homeowners with a perfect combination of living space conducive to each of those needs. The community is a managed, modern gated apartment development with well-designed 1BHK and 2BHK flats available to rent, suitable for the busy professional lifestyle.

Key Takeaways:

  • Conveniently located next to IT hubs such as Manyata Tech Park for easier commuting
  • Provides high-end, fully furnished flats with all essential modern amenities suitable for working professionals.
  • Great emphasis on security, neighborhood connectivity, and several lifestyle elements such as rooftop garden and gym.
  • Transparent rental agreements and managed services offer a worry-free living experience.

Kots Aube is well connected to various commercial areas across Bangalore, ideally suited for professionals looking to minimize your commute time.

  • Outer Ring Road Access: As it is well connected to Hebbal, Yelahanka & other key areas..
  • Public Transport: Also, several BMTC bus routes with taxi & auto stands nearby.
  • Upcoming HRBR Layout metro station will improve connectivity even further by mid-2026.

Frequently Asked Questions About Renting at Kots Aube in Hennur

Is renting at Kots Aube in Hennur a good choice for working professionals?
yes, it provides completely furnished apartments, great connectivity, and 24/7 security for a comfortable and hassle-free lifestyle.

Q2: What are the rental costs and deposit requirements at Kots Aube?
The rent for 1BHK apartments is approximately ₹26,800 to ₹30,000 per month plus 2-3 months of security deposit and all charges are completely transparent without hidden fees.

Q3: Are the flats fully furnished and ready to move in?
Yes, flats come fully furnished with modern interiors and essential appliances for immediate occupancy.

Q4: How is the connectivity and commute from Kots Aube to major IT parks?
It is close to Manyata Tech Park, 20 minutes by road, and has good public transport and upcoming metro connectivity.

Q5: What amenities does Kots Aube offer to support work-life balance?
Amenities offer a rooftop garden, gym, EV charging, housekeeping and maintenance services that provide a tranquil, balanced living experience.
